decisions.reason: Replacing the password-dependent legacy-field mechanism may affect how grey input cues are produced, but the client does not specify whether the grey appearance must change or can be preserved with a more robust field type.
Changing the underlying standard-placeholder mechanism does not alter the required behavior that placeholder text clears when the field is activated.
The source decision concerns the mechanism for ordinary fill-in prompts and does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting.
The request for a more robust fill-in field mechanism does not change the separate legacy-content migration and copy-paste stability requirements.
The source decision does not address manual line-break entry after legacy content is pasted.
Selecting a more robust standard-placeholder mechanism does not change the supported Word for Windows environment or general reliability constraint.
The source decision does not concern column placement or containment during pasted-content workflows.
The standard-placeholder mechanism is independent of bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, and approved appearance.
The source decision does not change the PBU style-name prefix, naming language, applicability, or covered style categories.
The standard text placeholder change does not affect numbered-list or multilevel-list alignment requirements.
The source decision does not modify the specified style system or its application across all templates.
The request for a more robust ordinary fill-in mechanism does not change table-paste stability or right-column boundary requirements.
